An '''emergency signal''' was a device used by individuals to report that they were in distress. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] carried one, and triggered it when he was [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|attacked]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
